planCharacteristics.planName: Tufts Health Plan Senior Care Options CW (HMO D-SNP)

BenefitUnlimitedComponent.bdBenefitUnlimitedDescription: 2 periodic or limited oral exams per year. 1 comprehensive and periodontal exam per year.
Intraoral, panoramic or tomosynthesis comprehensive exam every 36 months. 1 bitewing (1-4 images or tomosynthesis) per year. Cone beam CT (1 per 36 months).

1 filling per calendar year, per tooth same surface.
Crowns, core, post, pins covered once per tooth per 60 months.
Root canals, bone graft in conjunction with periradicular surgery, tissue regeneration; each covered once per lifetime, same tooth.

Periodontal scaling, root planing, & osseous surgery 1/36 mths per quadrant. Periodontal maint'ce 1/12 mths. Scaling in presence of generalized inflammation full mouth 2/12 mths. Bone replacement graft, first & each add'l site 1/lifetime same tooth. Guided tissue regen 1/lifetime same tooth.
Complete dentures covered once per 60 months. Partial dentures covered once per 84 months. Rebase or reline dentures covered once per 36 months.
Pontics and retainers covered once per tooth, per 60 months.

Alveoloplasty covered once per 6 months per quadrant. Reimplantation or stabilization of tooth covered once per lifetime. Bone replacement graft covered 1 per lifetime per quadrant. Guided tissue regeneration resorbable barrier covered 1 per 60 months same tooth.
Consultation covered once per year per provider. Occlusal guards covered once per 36 months.
